newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq shares post gains, small caps strong.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq shares post gains, small caps strong.

text.p: Nasdaq shares posted moderate gains on Monday, spurred by strength in small capitalization stocks and a jump in certain cable companies, traders said.

The Nasdaq composite index gained 7.19 points or 0.51 percent to close unofficially at 1412.03. Nasdaq shares traded in a tight six-point range, hitting a high of 1416.77 and a low of 1410.69 intraday. Advancing issues matched decliners on total volume of 565 million shares. Nasdaq shares have posted gains in six of the previous 10 sessions.
"There wasn't a great focus or direction among the big tech names, but there were some names like Comcast that were pretty hot today," one trader said.
Comcast Corp's Class A shares gained 3-3/16 to 21-7/16 after Microsoft Corp said it would invest $1 billion in the Philadelphia-based cable company.
Cable giant Tele-Communications Inc gained 1 to 16-1/16 after it agreed to sell 10 cable television systems in the New York area to Cablevision Systems Corp for 12.2 million Cablevision shares.
The Russell 2000 index, a key barometer of small capitalization stocks, gained 0.76 points to hit a new high of 387.90.
